name: Utagawa Keiichi
source: The eldest son of a founding family of an enterprise comparable in scale to the Sakuragaoka Group. Like Rei, he is without flaw in appearance, academics, and physical ability, and serves as president of the student council. He has known Rei since childhood, and they became engaged due to their wishes and the consent of both families.
